6deb7e08d7cf35b6.description:
Experience: 1+ years/someone who has exceptional knowledge and hands on experience
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Environment: Fast-paced startup

About the Role
We are looking for a skilled and driven Backend Engineer with strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot to join our engineering team. This is a backend-heavy role focused on building, maintaining, debugging, and scaling reliable microservices.
As a startup, we operate in a fast-paced environment where priorities can evolve quickly, execution matters, and engineers are expected to take ownership of their work. We are looking for someone who can move beyond simply implementing assigned requirements — someone who can understand problems, evaluate solutions, investigate unfamiliar technologies independently, and deliver high-quality results within deadlines.
You should have a strong understanding of Java internals, hands-on experience building Spring Boot microservices, solid problem-solving skills, and the ability to use AI-powered coding tools effectively to accelerate development without compromising code quality.

Key Responsibilities
• Backend Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services using Java 17/21 and Spring Boot.
• Microservices Architecture: Build and maintain scalable, resilient, and maintainable microservices.
• Reactive Programming: Work with Spring WebFlux and reactive programming principles where required.
• API Development: Design, implement, and maintain RESTful APIs with appropriate validation, error handling, security, and performance considerations.
• Database Engineering: Work with PostgreSQL and AWS RDS to design queries, optimize database performance, and maintain data integrity.
• Messaging & Caching: Implement asynchronous communication and event-driven workflows using Apache Kafka and caching mechanisms using Redis.
• Third-Party Integrations: Integrate external services and APIs into backend applications, handling authentication, failures, retries, and edge cases.
• Cloud Infrastructure: Work with AWS services to support the deployment, operation, and monitoring of backend applications.
• Debugging & Troubleshooting: Investigate production issues, identify root causes, and implement reliable fixes.
• System Design: Contribute to technical discussions involving service boundaries, data flow, scalability, resilience, and architectural trade-offs.
• AI-Assisted Development: Use tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and other AI-powered development tools effectively to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and code understanding.
• Ownership & Execution: Take responsibility for assigned tasks from requirement understanding through implementation, testing, debugging, and delivery.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with frontend engineers and other team members to deliver end-to-end product functionality.
Required Skills & Qualifications
• Java & Spring Boot
• Strong hands-on experience with Java 17 or Java 21.
• A solid understanding of Java fundamentals, object-oriented programming, collections, generics, exception handling, and concurrency.
• Good understanding of how Java works internally, including JVM architecture, memory management, garbage collection, class loading, and multithreading.
• Practical experience developing backend applications using Spring Boot.
• Understanding of dependency injection, Spring configuration, application lifecycle, and exception handling.
• Familiarity with Java AOP and its practical use cases.
• Understanding of reactive programming and hands-on experience with Spring WebFlux.
2. Microservices & System Design
• At least one year of hands-on experience developing or maintaining Java and Spring Boot applications, preferably in a microservices environment.
• Understanding of scalable and resilient microservices architecture.
• Knowledge of service-to-service communication, API design, failure handling, retries, timeouts, and fault tolerance.
• Decent understanding of system design fundamentals and common architectural patterns.
• Ability to identify edge cases and make sensible engineering trade-offs.
3. Databases & Messaging
• Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and relational database concepts.
• Understanding of SQL queries, joins, indexing, transactions, and query optimization.
• Familiarity with AWS RDS or similar managed relational database services.
• Working knowledge of Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, topics, and consumer groups.
• Familiarity with Redis and common caching patterns.
4. APIs, AWS & Integrations
• Strong understanding of REST API principles and hands-on experience implementing REST APIs in Java.
• Prior experience integrating third-party services or external APIs into backend applications.
• Basic practical knowledge of AWS and cloud-based application deployment.
• Understanding of API authentication, error handling, timeouts, retries, and secure handling of credentials.
5.Frontend Fundamentals
Although this is primarily a backend role, candidates should have a basic understanding of frontend development, including:
• JavaScript fundamentals.
• React.js fundamentals.
• Next.js fundamentals.
• How frontend applications communicate with backend services through APIs.
• How to investigate and debug basic frontend-to-backend integration issues.
Note: Advanced frontend development skills are not required; the primary focus of this     position is backend engineering.
6. AI-Powered Development Tools
• Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent tools.
• Ability to use AI tools effectively for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test creation, and understanding unfamiliar codebases.
• Ability to critically review AI-generated code, identify incorrect assumptions, and ensure correctness, security, and maintainability.
• Willingness to continuously improve development workflows using modern engineering tools.
Important: We value engineers who use AI tools to improve productivity while retaining strong fundamentals and the ability to reason about code independently.

What We Are Looking For
We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate the following qualities:
• Strong problem-solving ability: Can break down complex problems, reason through edge cases, and develop practical solutions.
• Ownership mindset: Takes responsibility for tasks and drives them to completion rather than waiting for constant guidance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment: Can adapt to changing priorities, manage competing tasks, and deliver within agreed timelines.
• Independent learning: Can investigate unfamiliar technologies, read documentation, debug issues, and figure things out with minimal supervision.
• Execution-focused approach: Understands the importance of delivering working solutions quickly without sacrificing essential engineering quality.
• Strong coding skills: Writes clean, readable, maintainable code and understands the underlying logic rather than relying solely on generated solutions.
• Adaptability: Comfortable working across different parts of the backend stack and collaborating with frontend engineers when needed.
• Analytical thinking: Can identify root causes instead of relying on temporary fixes.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience working in a startup or another fast-moving engineering environment.
• Experience troubleshooting backend issues in deployed or production-like systems.
• Familiarity with application logging, monitoring, performance analysis, and debugging tools.
• Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, automated testing, and code reviews.
• Familiarity with containerization and cloud-native application development.
Technology Stack
The primary technologies used in this role include:
• Languages: Java 17/21, JavaScript
• Backend Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring WebFlux
• Programming Concepts: Java AOP, reactive programming, concurrency
• Architecture: Microservices, REST APIs, system design
• Databases: PostgreSQL, AWS RDS
• Messaging: Apache Kafka
• Caching: Redis
• Cloud: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
• Frontend Fundamentals: React.js, Next.js
• AI Development Tools: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent
• Engineering Practices: Debugging, testing, performance optimization, and root-cause analysis
Why Join Us?
• Work in a startup environment where engineers can make meaningful technical contributions.
• Take ownership of backend services and solve real-world engineering problems.
• Work with modern backend technologies, cloud infrastructure, and microservices architecture.
• Learn quickly by working on challenging problems across the engineering stack.
• Use AI-powered development tools as part of a modern and productivity-focused engineering workflow.
Who Should Apply?
This role is best suited for an engineer who has solid Java and Spring Boot fundamentals, practical backend development experience, and the motivation to take ownership in a fast-moving startup.
If you enjoy solving difficult problems, learning independently, building scalable backend systems, and delivering solutions without waiting for every step to be prescribed, we would love to hear from you.

Headquarters: Sarasota, FL
 
URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/

SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role.

We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly.

As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch.

Key responsibilities

• Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS

• Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse

• Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools

• Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager

• Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on)

• Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along

Qualifications and skills

• You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working.

Required skills

• WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one.

• HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates.

• Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site.

• APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack.

• Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues.

• Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t.

• Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack.

• Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision.

Nice-to-have skills

• Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure.

• PHP development experience.

• Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients.

• Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices.

• Experience with Git and version control.

What success looks like

Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences.

• Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot.

• Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality.

• Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact.

• Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows.

• Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early.

• Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simpletiger-web-developer-wordpress-hubspot-u-s-based-remote-contractor

6de615ade7bc69de.description:
We are hiring an experienced Python Backend Engineer with 4-10 years of software development experience to design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems and enterprise applications for one of our clients in Pune.

The role focuses on developing robust APIs and services, integrating enterprise systems, and working closely with engineering and business teams to deliver reliable, high-quality software. It suits a hands-on engineer with strong Python fundamentals and practical experience building production-grade backend services.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using Python.
• Build and integrate RESTful APIs and work with JSON-based data structures.
• Develop services using frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
• Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data access layers (SQL and NoSQL).
• Integrate with enterprise systems, third-party services, and message queues.
• Analyze functional and technical requirements and translate them into effective software solutions.
• Develop, debug, test, and optimize backend components and integrations.
• Write unit and integration tests and maintain high code coverage.
• Troubleshoot application issues across services, databases, and infrastructure.
• Work closely with architects, frontend developers, QA, and business stakeholders.
• Participate in requirement analysis, technical design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
• Follow coding standards and engineering best practices, and participate in code reviews.
• Work within Agile methodologies, contributing to sprint planning, development, testing, and retrospectives.
• Continuously learn and apply new technologies to solve business problems.
• Take ownership of assigned work and ensure timely, high-quality delivery.

Required Skills

• 4-10 years of professional software development experience.
• Strong hands-on experience with Python (mandatory).
• Experience with at least one Python web framework (Django, Flask, or FastAPI).
• Strong experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with JSON.
• Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and SQL.
• Understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, and enterprise software principles.
• Experience with Git and version control workflows.
• Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
• Strong focus on code quality, reliability, and maintainability.
• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative engineering environment.

Additional Skills

• Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis) and caching.
• Experience with asynchronous programming and task queues (Celery, RabbitMQ, Kafka).
• Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is an added advantage.
• Knowledge of microservices architecture and API design.
• Exposure to Java or JavaScript/React is a plus.
• Experience with testing frameworks such as pytest.
• Experience working in large-scale enterprise application environments.
• Experience collaborating with distributed engineering teams is an added advantage.

Education

B.E. or B.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Employment Details

• Role: Python Backend Engineer
• Experience: 4-10 years
• Employment Type: Full Time
• Location: Pune
• Industry: Enterprise Technology

Compensation

Compensation will be based on experience, technical capability, and interview performance.

• Candidates with approximately 5 years of relevant experience can be considered up to ₹25 Lakhs for exceptionally strong profiles.
• Candidates with approximately 8 years of experience can be considered in the range of ₹35-40 Lakhs for exceptionally strong profiles.
• For exceptional candidates, compensation can be decided based on technical expertise, relevant experience, interview performance, and overall fit.

The BDR will maintain consistent engagement with prospective partners, coordinate meetings and introductions, track relationship progression, and ensure promising opportunities are appropriately qualified and advanced within the channel partnership process.  To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

• Consultant and Broker Relationship Development

• Build and maintain a strong network of relationships with healthcare consultants, brokers, advisors, and other influential industry stakeholders.

• Identify and engage key decision-makers, influencers, and relationship owners within national and regional consulting and brokerage firms.

• Establish the organization as a trusted and knowledgeable resource within the consultant and broker community.

• Develop relationships over time through consistent, thoughtful, and value-added engagement.

• Strategic Outreach and Business Development

• Develop and execute targeted outbound campaigns to consultant and broker organizations through email, phone, LinkedIn/social selling, events, networking, and other channels. 

• Research target firms, their areas of specialization, client portfolios, market priorities, and key stakeholders to create highly personalized outreach strategies.  

• Generate new conversations and qualified opportunities that align with the organization's growth and channel partnership objectives.  

• Leverage industry events, conferences, webinars, and other networking opportunities to expand the organization's consultant and broker relationships.  

• Opportunity Identification and Nurturing

• Identify emerging opportunities within consultant and broker organizations and proactively nurture relationships through the sales cycle.  

• Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects that are not yet sales-ready, keeping the organization top-of-mind for future client opportunities.  

• Understand consultant and broker influence within prospective accounts and identify opportunities where channel relationships can accelerate growth.  

• Coordinate introductions and discovery meetings between consultants/brokers and the appropriate internal sales or channel partnership leaders.  

• Maintain accurate and timely documentation of relationship activity, opportunities, next steps, and pipeline progression within CRM systems.  

• Channel Pipeline Development  

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective consultant and broker relationships and opportunities.  

• Partner closely with the SVP, Channel Partnerships to prioritize target firms, develop account strategies, and determine appropriate engagement approaches.  

• Provide regular reporting on outreach activity, relationship development, pipeline progression, and emerging market opportunities.  

• Identify trends, competitive dynamics, and market intelligence gathered through consultant and broker interactions and communicate relevant insights to leadership.  

• Internal Collaboration  

• Collaborate with Channel Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure coordinated engagement with consultant and broker partners.  

• Support preparation for consultant/broker meetings, presentations, industry events, and partnership discussions.  

• Help develop and refine messaging, materials, and engagement strategies designed specifically for the consultant and broker audience.  

• Support broader channel partnership initiatives and strategic growth priorities as directed by the SVP, Channel Partnerships.

• Performance & Results  

• Consistently achieve activity, relationship-development, qualified-opportunity, and pipeline-generation objectives.  

• Demonstrate disciplined follow-through and accountability in managing a large portfolio of prospective relationships.  

• Continuously test and refine outreach strategies to improve engagement, conversion, and channel pipeline performance.  

• Perform other related duties as assigned.  

About You 

• 2 - 5+ years of experience in healthcare, behavioral health, benefits, consulting, brokerage, business development, sales, or partnerships.  

• Experience working with or selling through healthcare consultants, benefits consultants, brokers, or other channel partners strongly preferred.  

• Demonstrated ability to develop relationships with senior stakeholders and build credibility within complex organizations.  

• Strong prospecting and business development skills, including experience with email, phone, LinkedIn/social selling, networking, and other outbound strategies.  

• Highly proactive, self-motivated, and comfortable independently managing a large portfolio of relationships and prospects.  

• Strong research and business acumen with the ability to understand an organization's business model, priorities, and key stakeholders.  

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to different audiences.  

• Strong organizational and follow-up skills with the ability to manage multiple relationships and opportunities simultaneously.  

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where opportunities may develop over an extended period.  

• Goal-oriented and results-driven, with a strong commitment to building sustainable relationships rather than simply generating transactional leads.  

• Collaborative team player who thrives in a mission-driven environment.  

• Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms preferred.

Benefits

• Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA

• 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%

• Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.

• Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible.

What you’ll do

You will manage a team of Associates. You will act in a player-coach capacity and are accountable for supporting associates in delivering against target set goals and mentoring in subject matter expertise.

Responsibilities

  • Ongoing management of the operational performance of your team to deliver KPIs

  • Ensuring your team has all the skills and resources needed to be successful in their role
  • Setting clear goals and expectations for individual and team performance
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement to refine team processes and procedures
  • Support recruitment and hiring initiatives
  • Coach and mentor individuals for career progression via structured career development conversations
  • Provide continuous performance feedback and facilitate periodic formal performance reviews
  • Drive and own initiatives that make the team a warm and welcoming place to work
  • Implement process improvements that enhance team productivity, reduce manual effort, and improve user experience

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years experience leading operations teams
  • Excellent interpersonal and communications skills
  • Exemplary planning and time management skills
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with multiple, cross-functional stakeholders to achieve results
  • Previous experience mentoring others and are able to constructively provide feedback to others
  • Ability to motivate the team and keep them engaged in an otherwise structured process
  • Proven ability to be subject matter experts in the relevant line of business
  • Previous experience in a team lead or people management role
  • Prior experience in customer service or internal/external user-facing operations

Preferred qualifications

  • Uses data to set priorities, track progress, and spot trends before they become problems. Comfortable building or maintaining dashboards and interpreting operational metrics
  • Brings numbers into conversations naturally and grounding decisions in evidence and making tradeoffs visible, not just reporting what the data says

6d8d62464d5b9f44.description: Job Purpose : We are seeking a highly skilled ETL Data Engineer to re-engineer our existing data pipelines to extract data from a new data source (PostgreSQL / CURA system) instead of the current Microsoft SQL Server (CRM persistence store), while preserving the existing load patterns to Elasticsearch and MongoDB. The engineer will ensure this migration has zero impact on data quality, system performance, or end-user experience. Key Responsibilities : - Analyze existing ETL pipelines and their dependencies on Microsoft SQL Server as source systems. - Design and implement modifications to repoint ETL extractions from PostgreSQL (CURA) while preserving the current transformations and load logic into Elasticsearch and MongoDB. - Ensure end-to-end data integrity, quality, and freshness remain unaffected after the source switch. - Write efficient and optimized SQL queries to extract data from the current source. - Conduct performance testing to confirm no degradation of pipeline throughput or latency in production. - Work closely with DevOps and platform teams to containerize, orchestrate, and deploy the updated ETLs using Docker and Kubernetes. - Monitor post-deployment performance and handle any production issues proactively. - Document design, code, data mappings, and operational runbooks. Required Skills and Qualifications : - Strong experience building and maintaining large-scale distributed data systems. - Expert-level proficiency in Python, especially data analysis/manipulation libraries like pandas, NumPy, and Polars. - Advanced SQL development skills with proven experience in performance optimization. - Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. - Familiarity with Elasticsearch and MongoDB as data stores. - Experience working in production environments with mission-critical systems. .
